programme.desc: Los mariachis se preparan para salir de serenata. Emiliano enfurece al darse cuenta que los hombres que pidieron la serenata quieren aprovecharse de Rosario. Todos los mariachis se darán golpes con los hombres hasta dejarlos a todos en el piso.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano no le cuenta a Rosario el motivo de la pelea. Rosario decide perdonarlo si no pelea con el Coloso esa noche, pero este lo provoca y Emiliano cae. Emiliano y el Coloso se irán a pelear a una bodega donde se darán golpes hasta desfallecer.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano habla con Martin sobre la vida de mariachi que lleva en Colombia. Martin no le creerá hasta que lo vea cantando en el bar Garibaldi. Por otro lado, el Coloso y Emiliano se baten a duelo por el puesto de cantantes en Garibaldi.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El duelo ha terminado y todos se dirigen a la oficina para votar. Sigifredo es el encargado de contar los votos, pero los resultados serán alterados. Por otro lado, Martin y Emiliano hablan de la llegada de este a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario y Emiliano cantan a dúo muy enamorados. Mientras tanto, Martin se va llorando para el hotel. Por otro lado, Emiliano le dice a Rosario que su familia ya consiguió la plata para el pasaje y que se va en unos días, pero promete volver.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo celebra el bautizo de su nieta en compañía del grupo de mariachis. Por otro lado, Martin llega a México y le informa a Steve que va para el rancho a confesarle la verdad a Roberto Sanchez. Steve pondrá sobre aviso a Corona.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Eulalia de Malagón pierde el control a ver a Carlos cerca de la señora Raquel. Por otro lado, los hombres de Thomas le hacen una emboscada a Martin en la carretera y lo asesinan. Don Roberto ordena buscar a Martin al ver que se está tardando.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Cristina entra en crisis de llanto al enterarse de la muerte de Martin. Por otro lado, Emiliano continúa ilusionado y malgasta el dinero sin saber lo que le sucedió a Martin.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se encuentra impaciente por la falta de comunicación con Martin. Por otro lado, Thomas amenaza a Miguel Corona y le advierte que si Emiliano habla, se encargara de matar a toda su familia y a la de Felipe Romero.

programme.desc: Mañanitas queda destrozado al ver que la mujer que intenta conquistar esta con Jairo. Emiliano se lleva a Mañanitas a la pensión y le pide a Lourdes que le quite la virginidad. Por otro lado, Fernando le cuenta a Emiliano lo de la muerte de Martin.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: South of Barcelona lies the Ebro Delta. Its beaches and lagoons are an exceptional refuge for migratory and native bird species. The delta is known for the numerous pink flamingos that nest near the glittering white saltworks. Sea salt is extracted and rice is cultivated in the delta. The impressive lake landscape is endangered to a certain extent by human intervention. For fear of their harvest, some rice farmers take action against flocks of birds. Invasive rice pests are also a threat to farmers in Europe's largest rice growing region. Other problems make the situation more difficult, such as climate change and rising sea levels or dams holding back sediments. What can be done to preserve the unique Ebro Delta?

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Rhine-Meuse Delta The Land of Canals
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies a unique biotope and a landscape characterised by water: the Rhine-Meuse Delta. Around a third of the Netherlands lies in the heart of Europe, below sea level, with 3,500 polders as a buffer for excess water and numerous cities crossed by canals. It is also a region where nature borders directly on cities, where intensive agriculture gradually leaves its place to the water, where the largest nature parks are in the immediate vicinity of Rotterdam's largest industrial port. From the sources of the Waal to the port of Rotterdam, we encounter protected plant, bird and mammal species, as well as the Delta inhabitants who have created this unique habitat.

programme.title: On Safari
programme.sub-title: Jamala Madikwe, Madikwe Game Reserve, North West Province
programme.desc: JAMALA MADIKWE, Sika's second Safari destination has been awarded “Most Romantic Lodge in South Africa” and is set around a Game-rich waterhole in the malaria-free Madikwe Game Reserve of the North West Province along the border of Botswana. Once an area consisting mainly of Cattle farms before it was transformed into a Wildlife Reserve in the early 90's. Today, the Reserve supports a thriving and incredible diversity of Species due to the fact that it lies in an ecological transition zone between the Kalahari and Lowveld Wilderness.

Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator and Reiki master. From fun with her family to her travels all over this great country Karen has fun where ever she goes. Her lighthearted confusion entertains kids of all ages. She is fascinated with the “afterlife” is convinced she will someday have a near death experience because, “I never finish anything.” She explains, “Sometimes a ghost will just do the same thing over and over in life. That's why I want to move into a house that is haunted by a maid." Karen's comedy is now featured in the new line of greeting cards called “Frank and Funny” sold at Target stores everywhere and is the comedy writer for “Haunted Magazine.” She is a regular on the Bob and Tom Radio Show and is a featured performer on their CD. Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham and Comedy Central. She has opened for show biz legends including Bob Hope, Ray Charles, David Brenner and the Monkees.

Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow.
